column1: # CHAOS-10366: the base images every Go image build starts from. Docker Hub official images, pulled today from mirror.gcr.io, which answers 429 under load.
# CI takes them from the ghcr.io mirror instead, by digest. Same format and one reader as ci/builder_images.tsv:
# <name><TAB><upstream ref: namespace/repo:tag@sha256:<digest of the multi-arch INDEX>>
# mirror-test-images.yml reads this file next to ci/builder_images.tsv, copies each ref verbatim into ghcr.io/<owner>/<namespace>/<repo>:<tag>
# (same digest), verifies the digest and that the index holds linux/amd64 and linux/arm64, then ci/verify_base_images.sh reads both the tag and the
# digest back WITHOUT credentials and fails unless they serve the pin (a private or missing package fails there). The Dockerfile ARGs
# (GO_BUILD_IMAGE, TOOLS_RUNTIME_IMAGE) carry these same refs; internal/cigates/workflows/workflows_base_images_test.go holds them equal.
# To bump an image: put the new index digest here and in the Dockerfile ARGs, and let mirror-test-images.yml publish it.
